_meta.purpose: Type-descriptor overrides for fields the upstream pabgb_complete_schema.json leaves as stream=?/type=?. Item_info type definitions ported from Potter420/crimson-rs (MIT) src/item_info/item.rs. StageInfo / FieldInfo / RegionInfo / CharacterInfo subset entries ported from NattKh/CRIMSON-DESERT-SAVE-EDITOR-AND-GAME-MODS (MPL-2.0 at time of port; license text bundled at src/cdumm/_vendor/crimson_rs/LICENSE_MPL2; copyright 2026 RicePaddySoftware). Resolves the 22 unknown-stream fields in ItemInfo so the parser can walk past them to reach _cooltime and the 70+ fields after it.
_meta.license: Mixed: MIT (Potter420 portions, credited per crimson-rs LICENSE) and MPL-2.0 (NattKh portions, copyright 2026 RicePaddySoftware, license text bundled with CDUMM).
_meta.format: Each table key may also have a special `_ordered_fields` array listing the deserialization order. When present, the loader REPLACES NattKh's field array with this order (NattKh's array is sorted by memory address, NOT serialization order). Field-level overrides set type descriptors. Verified empirically against vanilla iteminfo.pabgb 2026-04-27.
_meta.added_2026_04_27: Path B coverage: ItemInfo (113 fields), VehicleInfo (19), FieldInfo (19 of 26 — _complexData blocks the rest), StageInfo (81 of 82), RegionInfo (24), CharacterInfo (14-field mount subset). 6 tables, ~270 fields total.

VehicleInfo._meta_note: _unkPostVehicleCharKey discovered via iteration 13 systematic-debugging. NattKh's vehicleinfo_parser.py was 2 bytes short of entry_end and her _mountCallType / _canCallInSafeZone field labels actually pointed at the wrong byte positions (always 0 in observed data). Empirical truth: Horse (key=16960) has _canCallInSafeZone=1, which matches reading position +6 from end of entry, not +1. The 2 mystery bytes between _vehicleCharKey and _mountCallType are unknown but always 00 00 in vanilla data (Wyvern is the one exception with 03 00).

FieldInfo._meta_note: FieldInfo's last 4 fields (_regionKey1/2/3, _alwaysCallVehicle_dev) sit AFTER an undecoded variable-length field _complexData (sub_141A7CA00). NattKh's parser punts and reads them from end-of-entry. Until _complexData is reversed, the walker stops at field 21 and those targets need a field_schema rel_offset entry computed per-entry from end-of-entry.

StageInfo._meta_note: 82 fields ported from NattKh stageinfo_parser.py. Field _sequencerDesc (#7) has an optional-object variant (flag=1) NattKh's parser can't decode; entries with that variant fail cleanly via the StageInfo_SequencerDescOptObj tagged variant.

RegionInfo._meta_note: RegionInfo has NO entry header — _key and _stringKey are regular fields starting at byte 0 of the entry. NattKh's parser confirms (regioninfo_parser.py: 'There is NO per-entry name header in RegionInfo PABGB'). 24 fields ported from sub_141053790.

CharacterInfo._meta_note: Mount/vehicle subset only (11 fields) — ported from NattKh characterinfo_mount_parser.py. Targets: _vehicleInfo, _callMercenaryCoolTime, _callMercenarySpawnDuration, _mercenaryCoolTimeType. Fields after _mercenaryCoolTimeType are 'complex arrays/stats' that NattKh's mount parser skips; reaching them needs further RE.

WantedInfo._meta_note: Verified-only pass 2026-07-03. Only _increasePrice is validated: read as u64 at payload offset 0 (the default entry header consumes exactly key(2)+name_len(4, always 0)+null(1) = 7 bytes on every record, landing on the price). Values track the wanted tier — 30/50/100/500/1500 gold, consistent across all 5 key groups. _isBlocked/_useTargetPrice are all-zero in shipped data except one toggling flag byte whose name mapping can't be proven from the files alone (the field defs live only in the exe), so they are listed but gated as unverified rather than guessed. _stringKey (untyped in the base schema) stays dropped.

CORRECTION 2026-08-12: _failMessageInfoList shipped as CArray<[u8;33]>, a FIXED element width, and that was WRONG. The element ends in a LocalizableString read, so it has no constant width; the fixed value only fitted because every element string in this build is 16 bytes (17+16==33). Stage 2's candidate space contains no variable-element list shape, so it could not see the competing hypothesis and reported uniqueness inside an incomplete space. Both models tile 100% of records exactly, so the DATA cannot separate them -- the reader's disassembly can, and does. Now CArray<FailMessageInfo_Entry> (u32+LocalizableString). Exact tiling still holds under the corrected model, verified through CDUMM's own _consume_field_bytes.
